gaps: The fixed ASTRO BOT gameplay bar remains not passed. No blind A/B preference win or independent critic is claimed.
The 3D character is still small in the follow camera; larger scale risks hiding landings. Camera-size versus route visibility requires a new independent review.
Despite differentiated paving, landing footprints are still square and distant architecture and terrain remain sparse. Full environments and continuous animation are below the reference finish.
Ultracode and independent fresh-context workers were unavailable in the connected workspace; this iteration is explicitly author self-review.

The final Game 4 source passed 50 focused Node tests and eight real Chromium browser tests, and both builds passed. Local npm test for the entire games catalogue timed out after 175 passing subtests without a summary, so no new full-catalogue pass is claimed.

On the shared software GPU, a captured diagnostic frame gap reached 2,483ms. Final stills report 31 textures and 101–211 scene draw calls. These are not hardware FPS or performance readiness measurements.

Hardware FPS, long production GPU-memory soak, comprehensive accessibility/audio listening and full live audience operation remain unverified. The toolchain previously reported two high-severity npm audit findings.
Progress data automatically refreshes every five seconds while the page is open; it is not an unattended agent/builder scheduler. PR #55 remains draft and no deployment or merge is claimed.
